loops.name: engineering/adversarial-review-loop.md
loops.description: Has a second, independent model review every change before merge so two different reviewers must agree — code only lands when both clear the bar.

loops.name: engineering/anti-spin-build-loop.md
loops.description: Builds toward a machine-checkable contract with explicit anti-spin guardrails — stops on no progress, repeated approaches, flip-flopping, or a spend budget.

loops.name: engineering/build-test-fix-loop.md
loops.description: Builds the next item on the plan, then runs tests, typecheck and lint, feeding every failure back as the next instruction until the build is green.

loops.name: engineering/builder-reviewer-loop.md
loops.description: Passes code between a builder and an independent reviewer subagent until the review has no blocking findings and tests pass.

loops.name: engineering/completion-contract-loop.md
loops.description: Writes a contract of what "done" means and what evidence proves each requirement before any work starts, then refuses to claim success without that evidence.

loops.name: engineering/docs-sweep-loop.md
loops.description: Keeps documentation aligned with the current codebase and opens a reviewable pull request on every pass.

loops.name: engineering/five-minute-maintainer-loop.md
loops.description: Every few minutes while you work, makes one small verified repository improvement — a flaky test, a stale comment, a missing type — one change, one commit.

loops.name: engineering/goal-refiner-loop.md
loops.description: Rewrites a vague request into a precise goal — exact end state, how to verify it, what not to touch, and the stop condition — then executes against it.

loops.name: engineering/perf-budget-loop.md
loops.description: Profiles and optimizes the app pass after pass until it consistently meets a defined performance budget.

loops.name: engineering/production-error-sweep-loop.md
loops.description: Triages production errors, finds the root cause, ships a verified fix, and repeats until the error budget is clean.

loops.name: engineering/repo-cleanup-loop.md
loops.description: Recovers valuable unmerged work and prunes stale branches and PRs until the repository is tidy.

loops.name: engineering/test-coverage-loop.md
loops.description: Adds meaningful tests pass after pass until the suite reaches a target coverage threshold and stays green.

loops.name: engineering/ticket-to-pr-loop.md
loops.description: Converts open bug reports and issues into verified, reviewer-ready pull requests, one ticket per pass.

loops.name: evaluation/devils-advocate-loop.md
loops.description: Adversarially challenges a design or decision until every serious objection is resolved or explicitly accepted.

loops.name: evaluation/human-approval-loop.md
loops.description: Runs the task, then pauses and sends you approve / revise / skip before anything ships — human review as a first-class queue where the stop condition is your approval.

loops.name: evaluation/quality-streak-loop.md
loops.description: Runs realistic scenarios and fixes failures until the suite passes N times in a row with no regressions.

loops.name: operations/nightly-changelog-loop.md
loops.description: Updates the changelog every night with user-relevant changes and notifies the team when it ships.

loops.name: operations/overnight-pr-routine-loop.md
loops.description: A nightly routine that watches your open PRs, auto-fixes build failures, answers review comments in a fresh worktree, and rebases stale branches while you sleep.
